edges.effect_quant: Different designs and subgroups point in different directions, so a single pooled estimate is not the right way to read this edge.
edges.population: adults with ulcerative colitis or Crohn disease
edges.mechanism: Any benefit in IBD would likely come through reshaping microbial metabolites and mucosal immune signaling, though donor effects and durability remain inconsistent.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2026 Liu meta analysis in Eur J Pediatr already points to fecal microbiota transplantation produces mixed findings across studies, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: Subgroup differences, dose thresholds, and competing mechanisms likely explain why the literature does not settle into one clean direction.
